title: *ACC501 GDB SOLUTION*
text:
*ACC501 GDB SOLUTION*
Part	Requirement	Answer
(a)	Amount required today for Plan A (Rs.)	833,333
	Amount required today for Plan B (Rs.)	573,496
(b)	Affordable Plan (Plan A or Plan B)	Plan B
	Why? (Reason behind choosing affordable plan)	Plan B requires Rs. 573,496 today, which is within Mr. Nadeem’s available donation budget of Rs. 700,000, whereas Plan A requires Rs. 833,333 and exceeds his budget.
